ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Arbitrary File Download Using Office Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential arbitrary file download using a Microsoft Office application

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\EXCEL\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\POWERPNT\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WINWORD\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "Excel\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "POWERPNT\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "WinWord\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*")))
